run_svm_experiment: run a sacred experiment that trains an SVM classifier on the breast cancer dataset
create_sacred_experiment: create a sacred Experiment instance with a FileStorageObserver to log runs to disk
define_experiment_config: define experiment configuration using the ex.config decorator with local variables for hyperparameters
capture_config_params: capture experiment config parameters automatically using the ex.capture decorator on a function
enable_cli_integration: enable command line integration for the main function using the ex.automain decorator
